description: This is a PHP source file defining the EmployeeContactDetailsController class within the OrangeHRM project. It handles pre-render logic for displaying employee contact details, including setting up Vue components and permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeContactDetailsController
classes.description: Controller class that manages the pre-render setup for employee contact details view, including permissions and Vue component configuration.

methods.name: preRender
